content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing an issue with a counter in a [article_no] device. Although my logic seems correct and the counter activates appropriately, I can't see the current value updating in the programming software ([product_name] [version_no]) on my PC, nor can I retrieve the value using the memory area. Any suggestions? Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. There is a distinction between viewing the meter reading in simulation versus online testing. The value in the parameter table below the counter updates only during simulation. In online testing, this value is not refreshed automatically. To view the current counter value in the online test, move the cursor over the counter and click the displayed glasses icon. This will open a small output window showing the current value.
